extension.summary: A wall of live news tiles from your RSS and Atom feeds
extension.description: Fills an idle screen with Windows Phone style live tiles from your RSS and Atom feeds: pictures and headlines that flip, peek and roll, with fresh stories rotated in every few minutes. Mixed wall, Magazine, Spotlight and Mosaic layouts, an optional clock tile, Day / Night themes, night dimming and burn-in protection for OLED screens. Starts instantly from the cache and refreshes in the background; any key exits at once. Uses the RSS Live Tiles program's feeds and look when it is installed, or its own settings.
